FRIERENMOD-MARK_OF_PRIDE.title: Mark of Pride
FRIERENMOD-MARK_OF_PRIDE.description: Only for single-target Attacks. After playing, play it again against a different random enemy.
FRIERENMOD-MARK_OF_PRIDE.extraCardText: Play again against a different random enemy.
FRIERENMOD-HAMON_OVERDRIVE.title: Hamon Overdrive
FRIERENMOD-HAMON_OVERDRIVE.description: When played from the center of your [gold]Hand[/gold], refund the Energy spent on it.
FRIERENMOD-HAMON_OVERDRIVE.extraCardText: When played from the center of your [gold]Hand[/gold], refund the Energy spent on it.
FRIERENMOD-LOADED_DICE.title: Loaded Dice
